headline: PENDING - W1-VIABILITY-SPLIT is right and W1-19-r2's 40/40 is an artefact of hand-feeding. The defect is 8x larger than dispatched: 116 of 121 (quest,reveal) demands have NO producing route in play, across 8 of 9 channels.
next_step: reconcile mainline-chain-floor.mjs (find the hand-feed); prove a single reveal route end-to-end from play before authoring any at scale
notes: reports/blog-feed.jsonl and docs/shots/ are shared by every piece by protocol (rule 27); declared redundant, not a collision.
AUDIT RESULT (static, over game/data/quests/**, 120 quests): 121 distinct (quest,reveal) pairs are demanded by a resolution's requires_knowing. 5 are producible in play. 116 are not.
The 5 producible are ALL channel=book, and they work only because W1-LIBRARY round 2 built _bookKnowledgeIndex() -> ctx.knowledge. That is the ONE channel with a route.
Channels with ZERO producing route: ledger 28, talk_to_target 28, rival_npc 23, environment 18, eavesdrop 9, letter 6, later_quest 3, corpse 1.
9 quests have every resolution blocked: Q-MAIN-06,07,08,10,11,15,26,29,30. All mainline. Q-MAIN-06 is the first, which is exactly where the viability walk stops.
hooks.json: 0 of 139 rows (18 hooks + 121 entry_topics) carry a quest+reveal pair.
